branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A Frisian Gouda-style cheese from a farm family's own dairy brand, on the market since 2017 in four ages, from young to very aged. Its milk comes from farms in Friesland that farm regeneratively.

sources.text: A Frisian Gouda-style brand since 2017, with milk from Friesland farms, four ages and regenerative farming.
